copy_policy: A v0.7 workspace is created new-only under a distinct marker and cache namespace.
Compatibility copies are byte-exact and published under compatibility/v0.6.
The active v0.7 registry is never replaced, migrated, or activated by a copy.
Source, copied, and active-registry hashes reconcile in the receipt.
exclusions: No in-place cross-release migration or downgrade is implemented.
No copied registry is automatically activated.
No bundle, raw input, accepted output, export, or private source artifact is copied.
limitations: A registry does not encode enough evidence to prove its producing package version.
Full workspace migration, backup, rollback, CLI wiring, and side-by-side release acceptance remain pending REL-01 work.
A structural copy does not revalidate stored scientific payloads.
source_policy: The v0.6.0 tag and every source workspace/registry are read-only inputs.
A registry file must be regular, non-symlinked, closed, and free of WAL/journal files.
Registry structure is inspected through SQLite immutable read-only mode before copy.
